test_goal: Generate intersecting primitive slice recipes and verify the number and type of returned wire bodies.
risk_summary: Slice output uses wire-body semantics that can be accidentally treated as solid boolean output, hiding missing or invalid section wires.

geometry.parameter_notes: Use one clearly intersecting pair with an explicit wire-body count oracle.

expected_behavior: Intersecting inputs return the calibrated wire-body count.
notes: Return flat_recipe only; do not substitute api_boolean result-body semantics for slice wire counts.
